FX.title: [USD/JPY] UP: AI Detects Support at MA20 as Fundamentals Turn Bullish
tldr_points: USD/JPY remains in a strong bullish trend, trading well above the 20-period moving average at 158.08339920043946.
Persistent US inflationary pressures (October PPI at +6.5%) and hawkish Fed commentary support the US dollar across the board.
Overbought RSI (74.21234168554811) suggests potential consolidation, but any pullback toward the MA20 should be seen as a strategic buying opportunity.
FX.excerpt: USD/JPY bullish trend persists on hawkish Fed bets and rising yields. Key support is at the 20-day MA.
FX.comment: USD/JPY remains bullish as hawkish Fed bets and rising yields drive the pair higher, with key support at the 20-day MA of 158.08339920043946.

CRYPTO.title: [BTC/USD] UP: Oversold RSI-14 and Discount to MA20 Signal Mean-Reversion Long Amid Tokenized Settlement Catalysts
